# Lorica - Catholic Prayers, Novenas & Spiritual Warfare Armor

> Lorica is an ad-free sacred Catholic sanctuary providing studio-narrated prayers, 12 complete 9-day novenas with Holy Rosary decades, loopable night protection psalms, and an Examination of Conscience for Confession.

## Core Treasury & Sanctuary

- [Home & Sanctuary](https://loricaprayers.com/): Interactive Catholic prayer armory, audio player, and daily prayer tools.
- [Catholic Prayer Treasury](https://loricaprayers.com/#treasury): 46 traditional prayers categorized by Morning, Night & Sleep, Marian, Liturgical Latin, and Spiritual Warfare.
- [12 Complete Catholic Novenas](https://loricaprayers.com/#novenas): 9-day novenas paired with the 5-decade Holy Rosary.
- [Spiritual Warfare & SOS Armor](https://loricaprayers.com/#warfare): Emergency deliverance prayers, St. Michael Archangel protection, and Psalm 91 sleep loops.
- [Benefactor & Pilgrim Portal](https://loricaprayers.com/#portal): Sign-in and donor portal for the Perpetual First Friday Mass Covenant.

## Key Novenas (9-Day Prayers)

- [Surrender Novena](https://loricaprayers.com/novenas/surrender-novena/): "O Jesus, I surrender myself to You, take care of everything." Given by Jesus to Don Dolindo Ruotolo.
- [St. Michael the Archangel Novena](https://loricaprayers.com/novenas/st-michael-novena/): Spiritual combat armor and angelic protection against demonic oppression.
- [St. Jude Novena](https://loricaprayers.com/novenas/st-jude-novena/): Patron saint of hopeless cases and desperate situations.
- [Divine Mercy Novena](https://loricaprayers.com/novenas/divine-mercy-novena/): Novena dictated by Jesus to St. Maria Faustina Kowalska.
- [Our Lady Undoer of Knots](https://loricaprayers.com/novenas/undoer-of-knots/): Marian devotion for untying deep spiritual, family, and emotional knots.
- [St. Joseph Novena](https://loricaprayers.com/novenas/st-joseph-novena/): Terror of demons and patron protector of families, workers, and fathers.
- [St. Therese of the Child Jesus Rose Novena](https://loricaprayers.com/novenas/st-therese-rose-novena/): The Little Flower shower of roses novena for trust and grace.
- [Holy Souls in Purgatory Novena](https://loricaprayers.com/novenas/holy-souls-purgatory/): Intercession and suffrages for the holy souls awaiting heavenly glory.
- [Sacred Heart of Jesus Novena](https://loricaprayers.com/novenas/sacred-heart-novena/): Devotion of divine love revealed to St. Margaret Mary Alacoque.
- [Holy Spirit Novena](https://loricaprayers.com/novenas/holy-spirit-novena/): The Church's original novena prayed between Ascension and Pentecost.
- [Miraculous Medal Novena](https://loricaprayers.com/novenas/miraculous-medal-novena/): Devotion revealed to St. Catherine Labouré in 1830.
- [St. Andrew Christmas Novena](https://loricaprayers.com/novenas/st-andrew-christmas-novena/): Traditional Advent prayer recited 15 times daily until Christmas.

## Featured Prayers & Armor

- [Psalm 91: The Soldier's Shield](https://loricaprayers.com/prayers/psalm-91/): Ancient night prayer against terror, panic, and nocturnal attacks.
- [Lorica of St. Patrick](https://loricaprayers.com/prayers/lorica-patrick/): 5th-century Celtic breastplate invoking Christ on all sides.
- [St. Michael Deliverance Prayer](https://loricaprayers.com/prayers/st-michael/): Historic battle prayer composed by Pope Leo XIII.
- [St. Benedict Medal Exorcism](https://loricaprayers.com/prayers/st-benedict-exorcism/): Traditional blessing and warding against evil (Vade Retro Satana).
- [The Holy Rosary - Joyful Mysteries](https://loricaprayers.com/prayers/holy-rosary-joyful/): Five decades meditating on the Incarnation of Our Lord.
- [The Holy Rosary - Sorrowful Mysteries](https://loricaprayers.com/prayers/holy-rosary-sorrowful/): Five decades meditating on the Passion of Christ.
- [Night Compline Bedtime Prayer](https://loricaprayers.com/prayers/night-compline/): Traditional Night Office prayer for peaceful sleep and safeguarding.
